description: Experience a world-class centralized exchange designed for everyone - from beginners to professionals. Trade over 400 pairs with deep liquidity, industry-leading security, and up to 200x leverage on BTC, ETH, and other major assets. Join a platform built for performance, trust, and scale.
hero-description: At EasiCoin, we are committed to ensuring the safety and accessibility of your assets. To achieve this, we maintain a strict 1:1 reserve ratio to ensure that all funds held on our platform are fully backed and secure. User assets are matched by an equivalent reserve for full transparency and trust.
left-card-description: PoR enhances transparency while deposit certification protects your privacy.
left-card-title: EasiCoin 1:1 Reserves, Securing Your Asset Safety
por-content-1: Proof of Reserves (PoR) is a fundamental mechanism that ensures custodians maintain sufficient funds to cover all user assets and deposit liabilities, guaranteeing the platform's solvency.
por-content-2: Using advanced cryptographic attestation, EasiCoin can prove the existence of specific on-chain assets at a given point in time.
por-content-3: PoR is an essential cornerstone of the cryptocurrency trading ecosystem, enhancing trust and accountability among all stakeholders.
reserve-description: Reserve Ratio = Platform Reserves / User Assets. A reserve ratio above 100% means the platform can fully cover all user assets.
right-card-description: 1:1 reserves cover assets, cryptographic certification enables traceability
right-card-title: EasiCoin PoR: The Trust Cornerstone of Crypto Trading
